name: Disgrace
source:
The protagonist lives with his father and older brother. He was living in a dorm, but due to a renovation he's forced to return home. Because his father and brother work, he ends up spending all of his time alone in the house. The lady next door and her daughter take care of him since he is unable to cook for himself.

One day circumstances find our protagonist in a Soap Land.  Just who should greet him when he enters the shop... but the student teacher he has a crush on!

Released from the stifling dorm lifestyle,  how will our protagonist spend his new found freedom?

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8570]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
主人公与父亲、哥哥共同生活。他原本住在宿舍，却因宿舍翻修被迫回家。父亲与哥哥都要工作，家中大部分时间只有他一人。由于主人公不会做饭，隔壁的女性与她的女儿便经常照顾他。

一天，机缘巧合之下，主人公来到一家肥皂店。走进店内后，前来迎接他的竟然是他一直暗恋的实习教师！

摆脱令人窒息的宿舍生活后，主人公会如何享受这份新获得的自由？

[翻译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8570]Getchu.com[/url]的简介]
